title: MAFIA: Multi-Adapter Fused Inclusive LanguAge Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated intrinsically using StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs (Stereotype and Language Modeling scores), and extrinsically using Bias-STS-B to measure semantic textual similarity differences across 7 gender identities, as well as via subgroup AUC metrics in a toxicity classification case study.

Evaluated intrinsically using StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs, and extrinsically via multi-way comparison of semantic textual similarity (Bias-STS-B) across 10 racial/ethnic groups, alongside subgroup AUC metrics in a toxicity classification task.

Evaluated intrinsically using StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs, and extrinsically via semantic textual similarity (Bias-STS-B) across 11 religious identities, along with subgroup AUC metrics in toxicity classification.
Evaluated intrinsically using StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs, and extrinsically through semantic textual similarity (Bias-STS-B) utilizing professional terms.
Evaluated extrinsically using Subgroup AUC, BPSN, and BNSP metrics on the homosexual/gay/lesbian subgroup within the Kaggle Jigsaw unintended bias in toxicity classification dataset.
Evaluated extrinsically using ROC-AUC submetrics on the 'psychiatric_or_mental_illness' subgroup within the Kaggle Jigsaw toxicity classification dataset.
